description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker glm-4.7-flash-awq recipe for cyankiwi's GLM-4.7-Flash-AWQ-4bit (AWQ 4-bit compressed-tensors quantization of Z.ai GLM-4.7-Flash, MIT; checkpoint revision 25624b53) served by vLLM on two Sparks. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: glm45 reasoning and glm47 tool-call parsers, 202,752-token context, 4,096 batched tokens, 64 sequences and memory utilisation 0.8 (upstream defaults). eugr's optional fix-glm-4.7-flash-AWQ mod is commented out in the upstream recipe and is not applied. Tensor parallel 2 across the pair uses vLLM's native multi-node launch, eugr's default no-Ray cluster mode. No upstream performance claims are recorded. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: GLM 4.7 Flash AWQ 4bit vLLM two Sparks (eugr)
